verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs index publishes a canonical OpenAPI schema at /openapi/developer-api.json, and a live probe confirmed it returns HTTP 200 as a parseable OpenAPI document ("Ramp Developer API" v1, 174 paths). Ramp also offers equivalent machine-readable surfaces: a generated plain-text API reference (/llms-api.txt) and an unauthenticated Developer MCP that exposes the OpenAPI schemas. This covers the story with both first-party documentation and hands-on verification.
